+# Release Process

+

+This document describes how releases are created for Auto Claude.

+

+## Versioning

+

+**Version Format:**

+

+X.Y.Z-beta.N   (e.g., 2.8.0-beta.1, 2.8.0-beta.2)

+X.Y.Z-alpha.N  (e.g., 2.8.0-alpha.1)

+X.Y.Z-rc.N     (e.g., 2.8.0-rc.1)

+



+

+We follow Semantic Versioning:

+

+- **MAJOR (X.0.0):** Breaking changes, incompatible API changes

+- **MINOR (0.X.0):** New features, backwards compatible

+- **PATCH (0.0.X):** Bug fixes, backwards compatible

+

+## Beta Updates (User-Facing)

+

+Users can opt into beta updates in **Settings → Updates → “Beta Updates”**.

+When enabled, the app will check for and install beta versions. Users can

+switch back to stable at any time.

+

+## Release Flow

+

+Auto Claude uses an automated release pipeline that ensures releases are

+only published after all builds succeed.

+

+

+┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐

+│                           RELEASE FLOW                                       │

+├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤

+│                                                                              │

+│   develop branch                    main branch                              │

+│   ──────────────                    ───────────                              │

+│        │                                 │                                   │

+│        │  1. bump-version.js             │                                   │

+│        │     (creates commit)            │                                   │

+│        │                                 │                                   │

+│        ▼                                 │                                   │

+│   ┌─────────┐                           │                                   │

+│   │ v2.8.0  │  2. Create PR             │                                   │

+│   │ commit  │ ────────────────────►     │                                   │

+│   └─────────┘                           │                                   │

+│                                          │                                   │

+│                           3. Merge PR    ▼                                   │

+│                                    ┌──────────┐                              │

+│                                    │ v2.8.0   │                              │

+│                                    │ on main  │                              │

+│                                    └────┬─────┘                              │

+│                                         │                                    │

+│                     ┌───────────────────┴───────────────────┐               │

+│                     │     GitHub Actions (automatic)         │               │

+│                     ├───────────────────────────────────────┤               │

+│                     │ 4. prepare-release.yml                 │               │

+│                     │    - Detects version > latest tag      │               │

+│                     │    - Creates tag v2.8.0                │               │

+│                     │                                        │               │

+│                     │ 5. release.yml (triggered by tag)      │               │

+│                     │    - Builds macOS (Intel + ARM)        │               │

+│                     │    - Builds Windows                    │               │

+│                     │    - Builds Linux                      │               │

+│                     │    - Generates changelog               │               │

+│                     │    - Creates GitHub release            │               │

+│                     │    - Updates README                    │               │

+│                     └───────────────────────────────────────┘               │

+│                                                                              │

+└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

+



+

+## For Maintainers: Creating a Release

+

+### Step 1: Bump the Version

+

+On your development branch (typically develop or a feature branch):

+

+

bash

+# Navigate to project root

+cd /path/to/auto-claude

+

+# Bump version (choose one)

+node scripts/bump-version.js patch   # 2.7.1 -> 2.7.2 (bug fixes)

+node scripts/bump-version.js minor   # 2.7.1 -> 2.8.0 (new features)

+node scripts/bump-version.js major   # 2.7.1 -> 3.0.0 (breaking changes)

+node scripts/bump-version.js 2.8.0   # Set specific version

+



+

+This will:

+

+- Update apps/frontend/package.json

+- Update package.json (root)

+- Update apps/backend/__init__.py

+- Create a commit with message chore: bump version to X.Y.Z

+

+### Step 2: Push and Create PR

+

+

bash

+# Push your branch

+git push origin your-branch

+

+# Create PR to main (via GitHub UI or gh CLI)

+gh pr create --base main --title "Release v2.8.0"

+



+

+### Step 3: Merge to Main

+

+Once the PR is approved and merged to main, GitHub Actions will automatically:

+

+- Detect the version bump (prepare-release.yml)

+- Create a git tag (e.g., v2.8.0)

+- Trigger the release workflow (release.yml)

+- Build binaries for all platforms

+- Generate changelog from merged PRs (using release-drafter)

+- Scan binaries with VirusTotal

+- Create GitHub release with all artifacts

+- Update README with new version badge and download links

+

+### Step 4: Verify

+

+After merging, check:

+

+- GitHub Actions - ensure all workflows pass

+- Releases - verify release was created

+- README - confirm version updated

+

+## Hotfix Workflow

+

+For urgent production fixes that can’t wait for the normal release cycle:

+

+### 1. Create hotfix from main

+

+

bash

+git checkout main

+git pull origin main

+git checkout -b hotfix/150-critical-fix

+



+

+### 2. Fix the issue

+

+

bash

+# ... make changes ...

+git commit -m "hotfix: fix critical crash on startup"

+



+

+### 3. Open PR to main (fast-track review)

+

+

bash

+gh pr create --base main --title "hotfix: fix critical crash on startup"

+



+

+### 4. After merge to main, sync to develop

+

+

bash

+git checkout develop

+git pull origin develop

+git merge main

+git push origin develop

+



+

+> **Note:** Hotfixes branch FROM main and merge TO main first, then

+> sync back to develop to keep branches aligned.

+

+## Changelog Generation

+

+Changelogs are automatically generated from merged PRs using Release Drafter.

+

+### PR Labels for Changelog Categories

+

+| Label(s) | Category |

+|---------|----------|

+| feature, enhancement | New Features |

+| bug, fix | Bug Fixes |

+| improvement, refactor | Improvements |

+| documentation | Documentation |

+| (any other) | Other Changes |

+

+## Workflows

+

+| Workflow | Trigger | Purpose |

+|---------|---------|---------|

+| prepare-release.yml | Push to main | Detects version bump, creates tag |

+| release.yml | Tag v* pushed | Builds binaries, creates release |

+| validate-version.yml | Tag v* pushed | Validates tag matches package.json |

+| update-readme (in release.yml) | After release | Updates README with new version |

+

+## Troubleshooting

+

+### Release didn't trigger after merge

+

+Check if version in package.json is greater than latest tag:

+

+

bash

+git tag -l 'v*' --sort=-version:refname | head -1

+cat apps/frontend/package.json | grep version

+



+

+Ensure the merge commit touched package.json:

+

+

bash

+git diff HEAD~1 --name-only | grep package.json

+



+

+### Build failed after tag was created

+

+- The release won't be published if builds fail.

+- Fix the issue and create a new patch version.

+- Don't reuse failed version numbers.

+

+### README shows wrong version

+

+README is only updated after successful release. If release failed, README

+keeps the previous version (this is intentional).

+

+## Manual Release (Emergency Only)

+

+In rare cases where you need to bypass the automated flow:

+

+

bash

+git tag -a v2.8.0 -m "Release v2.8.0"

+git push origin v2.8.0

+



+

+> **Warning:** Only do this if you're certain the version in package.json

+> matches the tag.

+

+## Security

+

+All releases are:

+

+- Scanned with VirusTotal before publishing

+- Include SHA256 checksums for verification

+- Code-signed where applicable (macOS)

1️⃣ ADoor ACTOR (AUTHORITATIVE, REPLICATED)

ADoor.h

#pragma once



#include "CoreMinimal.h"

#include "GameFramework/Actor.h"

#include "Door.generated.h"



DECLARE_DYNAMIC_MULTICAST_DELEGATE_OneParam(FOnDoorLockStateChanged, bool, bLocked);



UCLASS()

class NYGHTSHADEHOLLOW_API ADoor : public AActor

{

    GENERATED_BODY()



public:

    ADoor();



    UPROPERTY(VisibleAnywhere)

    UStaticMeshComponent* DoorMesh;



    UPROPERTY(EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly, ReplicatedUsing=OnRep_Locked)

    bool bIsLocked = false;



    UPROPERTY(BlueprintAssignable)

    FOnDoorLockStateChanged OnDoorLockStateChanged;



    UFUNCTION(BlueprintCallable)

    void LockDoor();



    UFUNCTION(BlueprintCallable)

    void UnlockDoor();



protected:

    virtual void GetLifetimeReplicatedProps(TArray<FLifetimeProperty>& OutLifetimeProps) const override;



    UFUNCTION()

    void OnRep_Locked();



    void ApplyLockState();

};



ADoor.cpp

#include "Door.h"

#include "Net/UnrealNetwork.h"



ADoor::ADoor()

{

    bReplicates = true;



    DoorMesh = CreateDefaultSubobject<UStaticMeshComponent>("DoorMesh");

    RootComponent = DoorMesh;



    DoorMesh->SetCollisionProfileName("BlockAll");

}



void ADoor::LockDoor()

{

    if (!bIsLocked)

    {

        bIsLocked = true;

        ApplyLockState();

    }

}



void ADoor::UnlockDoor()

{

    if (bIsLocked)

    {

        bIsLocked = false;

        ApplyLockState();

    }

}



void ADoor::ApplyLockState()

{

    DoorMesh->SetCollisionEnabled(

        bIsLocked ? ECollisionEnabled::QueryAndPhysics

                  : ECollisionEnabled::NoCollision

    );



    OnDoorLockStateChanged.Broadcast(bIsLocked);

}



void ADoor::OnRep_Locked()

{

    ApplyLockState();

}



void ADoor::GetLifetimeReplicatedProps(TArray<FLifetimeProperty>& OutLifetimeProps) const

{

    Super::GetLifetimeReplicatedProps(OutLifetimeProps);

    DOREPLIFETIME(ADoor, bIsLocked);

}





This door:



Blocks movement when locked



Replicates cleanly



Broadcasts state changes for animation/UI



Requires no NavMesh rebuild



Collision blocking is enough. Keep it simple.

3️⃣ WIRE DOORS INTO LOCKDOWN (ScheduleManager or GameRules)



Add this to ScheduleManager.cpp (or GameRules if that’s your authority):



#include "Door.h"

#include "EngineUtils.h"



void AScheduleManager::StartLockdown()

{

    bLockdownActive = true;



    for (TActorIterator<ADoor> It(GetWorld()); It; ++It)

    {

        if (It->ActorHasTag("LockdownDoor"))

        {

            It->LockDoor();

        }

    }

}



void AScheduleManager::EndLockdown()

{

    bLockdownActive = false;



    for (TActorIterator<ADoor> It(GetWorld()); It; ++It)

    {

        if (It->ActorHasTag("LockdownDoor"))

        {

            It->UnlockDoor();

        }

    }

}

ESCALATION FLOW (THIS IS THE RULESET)

Inmate CurrentViolationLevel = 1

Guard disengages



Step 3: Intervention

Guard blocks path



Forces inmate schedule override to GuardTarget



CurrentViolationLevel = 2



Inmate movement is constrained but not restrained.



Step 4: Restraint



If inmate resists or keeps violating:



bIsRestrained = true



Movement speed = near zero



Guard escorts inmate to:



Holding cell



Seg intake point



Step 5: Segregation



Final step:



bInSegregation = true



Schedule overridden permanently (for now)



Inmate sent to TP_SegCell



Timer or condition required to release

PART 1: Door Actor (C++ Backbone)

Create C++ class



Parent: AActor

Name: NH_Door



NH_Door.h

#pragma once



#include "CoreMinimal.h"

#include "GameFramework/Actor.h"

#include "NH_Door.generated.h"



DECLARE_DYNAMIC_MULTICAST_DELEGATE_OneParam(FOnDoorLockChanged, bool, bLocked);



UCLASS()

class NYGHTSHADEHOLLOW_API ANH_Door : public AActor

{

    GENERATED_BODY()



public:

    ANH_Door();



    UPROPERTY(VisibleAnywhere)

    UStaticMeshComponent* DoorMesh;



    UPROPERTY(VisibleAnywhere)

    UBoxComponent* Blocker;



    UPROPERTY(ReplicatedUsing=OnRep_LockState, BlueprintReadOnly)

    bool bIsLocked = false;



    UPROPERTY(BlueprintAssignable)

    FOnDoorLockChanged OnDoorLockChanged;



    UFUNCTION(BlueprintCallable)

    void LockDoor();



    UFUNCTION(BlueprintCallable)

    void UnlockDoor();



protected:

    virtual void GetLifetimeReplicatedProps(TArray<FLifetimeProperty>& OutLifetimeProps) const override;



    UFUNCTION()

    void OnRep_LockState();

};



NH_Door.cpp

#include "NH_Door.h"

#include "Components/StaticMeshComponent.h"

#include "Components/BoxComponent.h"

#include "Net/UnrealNetwork.h"



ANH_Door::ANH_Door()

{

    bReplicates = true;



    DoorMesh = CreateDefaultSubobject<UStaticMeshComponent>(TEXT("DoorMesh"));

    RootComponent = DoorMesh;



    Blocker = CreateDefaultSubobject<UBoxComponent>(TEXT("Blocker"));

    Blocker->SetupAttachment(RootComponent);

    Blocker->SetCollisionProfileName("BlockAll");

    Blocker->SetHiddenInGame(true);

}



void ANH_Door::LockDoor()

{

    if (!bIsLocked)

    {

        bIsLocked = true;

        Blocker->SetCollisionEnabled(ECollisionEnabled::QueryAndPhysics);

        OnDoorLockChanged.Broadcast(true);

    }

}



void ANH_Door::UnlockDoor()

{

    if (bIsLocked)

    {

        bIsLocked = false;

        Blocker->SetCollisionEnabled(ECollisionEnabled::NoCollision);

        OnDoorLockChanged.Broadcast(false);

    }

}



void ANH_Door::OnRep_LockState()

{

    Blocker->SetCollisionEnabled(

        bIsLocked ? ECollisionEnabled::QueryAndPhysics : ECollisionEnabled::NoCollision

    );



    OnDoorLockChanged.Broadcast(bIsLocked);

}



void ANH_Door::GetLifetimeReplicatedProps(TArray<FLifetimeProperty>& OutLifetimeProps) const

{

    Super::GetLifetimeReplicatedProps(OutLifetimeProps);

    DOREPLIFETIME(ANH_Door, bIsLocked);

}





What this does



Blocker physically blocks movement + NavMesh



No teleporting NPCs



No rebuilding nav every time



Works in PIE and multiplayer



PART 2: Hook Doors Into Lockdown



You already have GameRules / ScheduleManager. We extend it.



In ScheduleManager.h



Add:



UFUNCTION(BlueprintCallable)

void SetLockdown(bool bEnable);



In ScheduleManager.cpp

#include "NH_Door.h"



void AScheduleManager::SetLockdown(bool bEnable)

{

    for (TActorIterator<ANH_Door> It(GetWorld()); It; ++It)

    {

        if (bEnable)

        {

            It->LockDoor();

        }

        else

        {

            It->UnlockDoor();

        }

    }

}





Now when lockdown triggers, doors respond globally.

void UInmateAuthorityComponent::RegisterViolation_Internal(

    EViolationType Type,

    int32 Severity,

    FName ReportingGuard,

    const FString& Context)

    AuthorityLevel = FMath::Clamp(AuthorityLevel + Severity, 0, 5);

2️⃣ InmateJudicialComponent — AUTOMATIC TICK VIA SCHEDULEMANAGER



Punishments do not self-tick.

InmateJudicialComponent.h (ADD)

void AdvanceJudicialTime(float DeltaSeconds);



InmateJudicialComponent.cpp (FIXED)

void UInmateJudicialComponent::AdvanceJudicialTime(float DeltaSeconds)

{

    for (int32 i = ActivePunishments.Num() - 1; i >= 0; --i)

    {

        FPunishmentRecord& P = ActivePunishments[i];

        if (P.Duration < 0.f) continue;



        P.TimeServed += DeltaSeconds;



        if (P.TimeServed >= P.Duration)

        {

            ActivePunishments.RemoveAt(i);

        }

    }

}





No timers.

No Tick() on inmates.

One clock. One authority.

bool UNH_ScheduleComponent::IsScheduleOverriddenByJudicial() const

4️⃣ ScheduleManager — SINGLE AUTHORITY LOOP (THE SPINE)



This is where everything meets.



ScheduleManager.cpp (ADD TO TICK OR TIMER)

void AScheduleManager::AuthorityTick(float DeltaSeconds)

{

    for (TActorIterator<ACharacter> It(GetWorld()); It; ++It)

    {

        auto* Judicial = It->FindComponentByClass<UInmateJudicialComponent>();

        auto* Authority = It->FindComponentByClass<UInmateAuthorityComponent>();



        if (Judicial)

        {

            Judicial->AdvanceJudicialTime(DeltaSeconds);

        }



        if (Authority)

        {

            Authority->DecayAuthority(DeltaSeconds);

        }

    }

}





Call this from:



GameState minute tick



Or a 1-second server timer



This is now the single integration point you demanded.

UInmateAuthorityComponent::UInmateAuthorityComponent()

{

    SetIsReplicatedByDefault(true);

    AuthorityLevel = 0;

void UInmateAuthorityComponent::RegisterViolation(

    EViolationType Type,

    int32 Severity,

    FName ReportingGuard,

    const FString& Context)

{

    if (GetOwner()->HasAuthority())

    {

        RegisterViolation_Internal(Type, Severity, ReportingGuard, Context);

    }

    else

    {

        Server_RegisterViolation(Type, Severity, ReportingGuard, Context);

    }

    EViolationType Type,

    int32 Severity,

    FName ReportingGuard,

    const FString& Context)

{

    RegisterViolation_Internal(Type, Severity, ReportingGuard, Context);

}



void UInmateAuthorityComponent::RegisterViolation_Internal(

    EViolationType Type,

    int32 Severity,

    FName ReportingGuard,

void UInmateJudicialComponent::AdvanceJudicialTime(float DeltaSeconds)

{

    for (int32 i = ActivePunishments.Num() - 1; i >= 0; --i)

    {

        FPunishmentRecord& P = ActivePunishments[i];



        if (P.Duration < 0.f) continue;



        P.TimeServed += DeltaSeconds;



        if (P.TimeServed >= P.Duration)

        {

            ActivePunishments.RemoveAt(i);

        }

    }

}





✅ No timers.

✅ No drift.

✅ One authority clock.

PHASE 5.1 — PAROLE ELIGIBILITY MODEL



Eligibility is computed, not granted.



Add to InmateJudicialComponent.h

UFUNCTION(BlueprintCallable)

bool IsEligibleForParole() const;



InmateJudicialComponent.cpp

bool UInmateJudicialComponent::IsEligibleForParole() const

{

    float TotalServed = 0.f;

    float TotalDuration = 0.f;



    for (const FPunishmentRecord& P : ActivePunishments)

    {

        if (P.Duration < 0.f) return false; // Indefinite = no parole

        TotalServed += P.TimeServed;

        TotalDuration += P.Duration;

    }



    if (TotalDuration <= 0.f) return false;



    const float ServedRatio = TotalServed / TotalDuration;

    return ServedRatio >= 0.6f; // 60% served minimum (tunable)

}





Canon rules:



Indefinite segregation = no parole



Repeat offenders raise the threshold later



Faction hostility can invalidate eligibility (Phase 6)

void UParoleBoardComponent::EvaluateParole(ACharacter* Inmate)

{

    auto* Judicial = Inmate->FindComponentByClass<UInmateJudicialComponent>();

    auto* Authority = Inmate->FindComponentByClass<UInmateAuthorityComponent>();



    if (!Judicial || !Authority) return;



    if (!Judicial->IsEligibleForParole())

    {

        DenyParole(Inmate, TEXT("Sentence not sufficiently served"));

        return;

    }



    if (Authority->AuthorityLevel >= 3)

    {

        DenyParole(Inmate, TEXT("High institutional risk"));

        return;

    }



    ApproveParole(Inmate, TEXT("Compliance satisfactory"));

}



void UParoleBoardComponent::ApproveParole(ACharacter* Inmate, const FString& Reason)

{

    UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("Parole approved for %s: %s"),

        *Inmate->GetName(), *Reason);



    // Phase 6 hook: faction response

    Inmate->FindComponentByClass<UInmateJudicialComponent>()

        ->ActivePunishments.Empty();

}



void UParoleBoardComponent::DenyParole(ACharacter* Inmate, const FString& Reason)

{

    UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("Parole denied for %s: %s"),

        *Inmate->GetName(), *Reason);



    // Extend sentence slightly

    Reputation.Add(EFaction::YardCrew, 0.f);

    Reputation.Add(EFaction::WorkDetail, 0.f);

}



float UFactionReputationComponent::GetReputation(EFaction Faction) const

{

    if (const float* Value = Reputation.Find(Faction))

    {

        return *Value;

    }

    return 0.f;

}



void UFactionReputationComponent::ModifyReputation(EFaction Faction, float Delta)

{

    Reputation.FindOrAdd(Faction) =

        FMath::Clamp(GetReputation(Faction) + Delta, -100.f, 100.f);

}



void UFactionReputationComponent::GetLifetimeReplicatedProps(TArray<FLifetimeProperty>& Out) const

{

    Super::GetLifetimeReplicatedProps(Out);

    DOREPLIFETIME(UFactionReputationComponent, Reputation);

}

$ErrorActionPreference = "SilentlyContinue"



$roots = @(

  "C:\Users\FRANK\Desktop\ltvall\shiny-happiness",

  "C:\Users\FRANK\Documents\Unreal Projects",

  "C:\Users\FRANK\Desktop",

  "D:\",

  "C:\"

) | Where-Object { Test-Path $_ }



Write-Host "=== Searching for .uproject files ===" -ForegroundColor Cyan



$uprojects = foreach ($r in $roots) {

  Get-ChildItem -Path $r -Filter *.uproject -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

}



$report = $uprojects | ForEach-Object {

  $p = $_.FullName

  $dir = Split-Path $p -Parent

  [pscustomobject]@{

    UProject = $p

    HasSource = Test-Path (Join-Path $dir "Source")

    HasContent = Test-Path (Join-Path $dir "Content")

    HasConfig = Test-Path (Join-Path $dir "Config")

    SourceCount = (Get-ChildItem (Join-Path $dir "Source") -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Measure-Object).Count

    ContentCount = (Get-ChildItem (Join-Path $dir "Content") -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Measure-Object).Count

  }

} | Sort-Object HasSource,HasContent,SourceCount,ContentCount -Descending



$report | Format-Table -AutoSize



$report | Export-Csv "$env:USERPROFILE\Desktop\NH_UPROJECT_AUDIT.csv" -NoTypeInformation

Write-Host "`nWrote: $env:USERPROFILE\Desktop\NH_UPROJECT_AUDIT.csv" -ForegroundColor Green

Pick the project that has:



Source/ present



Content/ non-empty



and is the one you actually open in UE (sounds like ...shiny-happiness\THENYGHTSHADEHOLLOW\THENYGHTSHADEHOLLOW.uproject or ...Documents\Unreal Projects\pickelsmodin\pickelsmodin.uproject)



Everything else is noise.



2) Build a Vault manifest (so imports are deterministic)

This creates VAULT_MAP.txt and FBX_ONLY.txt on your Desktop.



$Vault = "C:\Nyghtshade_Assets_Vault"

if (!(Test-Path $Vault)) { $Vault = "D:\Nyghtshade_Assets_Vault" }



if (!(Test-Path $Vault)) {

  Write-Host "Vault not found at C:\ or D:\. Fix the vault path first." -ForegroundColor Red

  exit 1

}



$all = Get-ChildItem $Vault -Recurse -File -Force |

  Where-Object { $_.Extension -match '\.(fbx|png|tga|jpg|jpeg|exr|wav|uasset|umap)$' }



$all.FullName | Out-File "$env:USERPROFILE\Desktop\VAULT_MAP.txt" -Encoding utf8



$all | Where-Object { $_.Extension -ieq ".fbx" } |

  Select-Object -ExpandProperty FullName |

  Out-File "$env:USERPROFILE\Desktop\FBX_ONLY.txt" -Encoding utf8



Write-Host "Wrote VAULT_MAP.txt and FBX_ONLY.txt to Desktop." -ForegroundColor Green

3) Unreal Python importer (imports FBX + textures, makes master materials, logs success)

Create this file inside your UE project at:



<YourProject>\Scripts\vault_to_unreal.py



import os

import re

import unreal

from datetime import datetime



# ---------------------------

# CONFIG

# ---------------------------

VAULT_MANIFEST = r"C:\Users\FRANK\Desktop\FBX_ONLY.txt"  # change if needed

DEST_ROOT = "/Game/Nyghtshade/Final_Prison_Assets"       # where meshes/materials land

LOG_PATH = r"C:\Users\FRANK\Desktop\IMPORT_SUCCESS.log"



# Master material names (will be created if missing)

MASTER_CONCRETE = f"{DEST_ROOT}/Materials/M_Master_Concrete"

MASTER_METAL     = f"{DEST_ROOT}/Materials/M_Master_Metal"



# Texture name heuristics

PAT_BASE   = re.compile(r"(basecolor|albedo|diffuse|_d$|_bc$)", re.IGNORECASE)

PAT_NORMAL = re.compile(r"(normal|_n$)", re.IGNORECASE)

PAT_ORM    = re.compile(r"(orm|occlusionroughnessmetallic)", re.IGNORECASE)

PAT_R      = re.compile(r"(_r$|roughness)", re.IGNORECASE)

PAT_M      = re.compile(r"(_m$|metallic)", re.IGNORECASE)

PAT_AO     = re.compile(r"(ao|occlusion)", re.IGNORECASE)



# ---------------------------

# LOGGING

# ---------------------------

def log(line: str):

    stamp = datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")

    msg = f"[{stamp}] {line}"

    unreal.log(msg)

    with open(LOG_PATH, "a", encoding="utf-8") as f:

        f.write(msg + "\n")



# ---------------------------

# HELPERS

# ---------------------------

def ensure_dir(asset_path: str):

    if not unreal.EditorAssetLibrary.does_directory_exist(asset_path):

        unreal.EditorAssetLibrary.make_directory(asset_path)



def asset_exists(asset_path: str) -> bool:

    return unreal.EditorAssetLibrary.does_asset_exist(asset_path)



def load_asset(asset_path: str):

    return unreal.EditorAssetLibrary.load_asset(asset_path)



def create_master_material(asset_path: str):

    """

    Creates a minimal PBR master material with texture params:

      BaseColorTex, NormalTex, ORMTex, RoughnessTex, MetallicTex, AOTex

    """

    if asset_exists(asset_path):

        return load_asset(asset_path)



    ensure_dir(os.path.dirname(asset_path).replace("\\", "/"))



    factory = unreal.MaterialFactoryNew()

    asset_tools = unreal.AssetToolsHelpers.get_asset_tools()

    name = asset_path.split("/")[-1]

    pkg = "/".join(asset_path.split("/")[:-1])



    mat = asset_tools.create_asset(name, pkg, unreal.Material, factory)

    mel = unreal.MaterialEditingLibrary



    # BaseColor

    bc = mel.create_material_expression(mat, unreal.MaterialExpressionTextureSampleParameter2D, -600, -200)

    bc.set_editor_property("parameter_name", "BaseColorTex")

    mel.connect_material_property(bc, "RGB", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_BASE_COLOR)



    # Normal

    n = mel.create_material_expression(mat, unreal.MaterialExpressionTextureSampleParameter2D, -600, 0)

    n.set_editor_property("parameter_name", "NormalTex")

    n.set_editor_property("sampler_type", unreal.MaterialSamplerType.SAMPLERTYPE_NORMAL)

    mel.connect_material_property(n, "RGB", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_NORMAL)



    # ORM (packed)

    orm = mel.create_material_expression(mat, unreal.MaterialExpressionTextureSampleParameter2D, -600, 200)

    orm.set_editor_property("parameter_name", "ORMTex")



    # Split ORM channels: R=AO, G=Roughness, B=Metallic (common convention)

    mel.connect_material_property(orm, "G", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_ROUGHNESS)

    mel.connect_material_property(orm, "B", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_METALLIC)

    mel.connect_material_property(orm, "R", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_AMBIENT_OCCLUSION)



    mel.recompile_material(mat)

    unreal.EditorAssetLibrary.save_asset(asset_path)

    log(f"Created master material: {asset_path}")

    return mat



def guess_master_for_mesh(filename: str) -> str:

    # crude but effective: metal keywords => metal, else concrete

    lower = filename.lower()

    if any(k in lower for k in ["metal", "steel", "bar", "grate", "chain", "door", "gate", "pipe"]):

        return MASTER_METAL

    return MASTER_CONCRETE



def import_fbx(fbx_path: str, dest_path: str):

    ensure_dir(dest_path)



    task = unreal.AssetImportTask()

    task.filename = fbx_path

    task.destination_path = dest_path

    task.automated = True

    task.save = True

    task.replace_existing = False



    options = unreal.FbxImportUI()

    options.import_mesh = True

    options.import_textures = True

    options.import_materials = True

    options.mesh_type_to_import = unreal.FBXImportType.FBXIT_STATIC_MESH

    options.static_mesh_import_data.combine_meshes = False



    task.options = options



    unreal.AssetToolsHelpers.get_asset_tools().import_asset_tasks([task])



    imported = task.imported_object_paths

    return imported



def fixup_redirectors(root="/Game"):

    asset_tools = unreal.AssetToolsHelpers.get_asset_tools()

    redirectors = unreal.EditorAssetLibrary.list_assets(root, recursive=True, include_folder=True)

    reds = []

    for a in redirectors:

        if a.endswith(".Redirector"):

            reds.append(load_asset(a))

    if reds:

        asset_tools.fixup_redirectors(reds)

        log(f"FixupRedirectors: fixed {len(reds)} redirectors")

    else:

        log("FixupRedirectors: none found")



# ---------------------------

# MAIN

# ---------------------------

def main():

    # start fresh log line

    log("=== VAULT IMPORT START ===")



    if not os.path.exists(VAULT_MANIFEST):

        log(f"ERROR: Manifest missing: {VAULT_MANIFEST}")

        return



    # Ensure material folders

    ensure_dir(f"{DEST_ROOT}/Materials")

    ensure_dir(f"{DEST_ROOT}/Meshes")



    # Create master materials

    create_master_material(MASTER_CONCRETE)

    create_master_material(MASTER_METAL)



    # Import FBX list

    with open(VAULT_MANIFEST, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:

        fbx_files = [ln.strip() for ln in f.readlines() if ln.strip()]



    ok = 0

    fail = 0



    for fbx in fbx_files:

        try:

            if not os.path.exists(fbx):

                log(f"SKIP (missing): {fbx}")

                continue



            imported = import_fbx(fbx, f"{DEST_ROOT}/Meshes")

            if imported:

                ok += 1

                log(f"IMPORTED: {fbx} -> {imported}")

            else:

                fail += 1

                log(f"FAILED (no outputs): {fbx}")



        except Exception as e:

            fail += 1

            log(f"FAILED (exception): {fbx} :: {e}")



    fixup_redirectors(DEST_ROOT)



    log(f"=== VAULT IMPORT END | OK={ok} FAIL={fail} ===")



main()

Run it (the correct way)

You do not run this with normal Python. You run it via Unreal Editor:

5) Build without your Ryzen 1700X doing a dramatic faint

From the UE project folder:



$UEBT = "C:\Program Files\Epic Games\UE_5.7\Engine\Binaries\DotNET\UnrealBuildTool\UnrealBuildTool.exe"

$Target = "THENYGHTSHADEHOLLOWEditor"

$Platform = "Win64"

$Config = "Development"



# Conservative parallelism for 1700X stability

& $UEBT $Target $Platform $Config -MaxParallelActions=6

If you build via VS/MSBuild, set Tools → Options → Projects → Build and Run → maximum parallel project builds to something sane (like 2–4). You’re not proving anything by crashing.



6) Git: commit the real stuff (and don’t shove 80GB into normal Git)

If you’re committing .uasset heavy content, you want Git LFS. If you refuse, the repo will turn into a landfill.



git lfs install

git lfs track "*.uasset" "*.umap"

git add .gitattributes

git add Content Scripts Source Config

git commit -m "Import prison assets + stabilize core pipeline"

git push

Two important reality checks (because earlier agents went full fantasy mode)

“Java 21” has nothing to do with Unreal C++ builds. If someone told you that, they were improvising a bedtime story.



“Unsupported Class Version” in UE is usually asset serialization/version mismatch (assets saved in a newer engine, plugin mismatch, corrupted bulkdata), not Java, not vibes.



Your next move (and I’m not making it optional)

Run the audit script and open the NH_UPROJECT_AUDIT.csv. That tells you what’s authoritative, instantly. Then run the Unreal Python import exactly as above and read IMPORT_SUCCESS.log.



If you do that, the “Frankenstein” stops being mythological and becomes a folder with receipts.

1) Tools\nh_foreman_audit.ps1

param(

  [Parameter(Mandatory=$true)]

  [string]$WorkspaceRoot,



  [string]$OutCsv = (Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE "Desktop\NH_UPROJECT_AUDIT.csv")

)



$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"



function Get-HeuristicScore {

  param([string]$UProjectPath)



  $dir = Split-Path $UProjectPath -Parent

  $pLower = $UProjectPath.ToLowerInvariant()

  $dLower = $dir.ToLowerInvariant()



  $score = 0



  # Strong positives

  if ($pLower -match "nyghtshade") { $score += 300 }

  if ($pLower -match "thenyghtshadehollow") { $score += 400 }

  if (Test-Path (Join-Path $dir "Content")) { $score += 150 }

  if (Test-Path (Join-Path $dir "Config"))  { $score += 80 }

  if (Test-Path (Join-Path $dir "Source"))  { $score += 220 }



  # File density: lots of content usually means "real project"

  $contentCount = 0

  $sourceCount  = 0

  if (Test-Path (Join-Path $dir "Content")) {

    $contentCount = (Get-ChildItem (Join-Path $dir "Content") -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Measure-Object).Count

    $score += [Math]::Min(300, [int]($contentCount / 200))

  }

  if (Test-Path (Join-Path $dir "Source")) {

    $sourceCount = (Get-ChildItem (Join-Path $dir "Source") -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Measure-Object).Count

    $score += [Math]::Min(250, [int]($sourceCount / 40))

  }



  # Strong negatives: engine templates, staged builds, Program Files, etc.

  if ($dLower -like "*\program files\epic games\ue_*") { $score -= 1000 }

  if ($dLower -like "*\templates\*") { $score -= 1000 }

  if ($dLower -like "*\saved\stagedbuilds\*") { $score -= 700 }

  if ($dLower -like "*\nyghtshade_final_release\*") { $score -= 500 }

  if ($dLower -like "*\engine\source\programs\*") { $score -= 900 }



  return [pscustomobject]@{

    Score        = $score

    ContentCount = $contentCount

    SourceCount  = $sourceCount

  }

}



Write-Host "=== Foreman Audit: Searching for .uproject under $WorkspaceRoot ===" -ForegroundColor Cyan

if (!(Test-Path $WorkspaceRoot)) { throw "WorkspaceRoot not found: $WorkspaceRoot" }



$uprojects = Get-ChildItem -Path $WorkspaceRoot -Filter *.uproject -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

if (-not $uprojects) {

  throw "No .uproject files found under $WorkspaceRoot"

}



$report = foreach ($u in $uprojects) {

  $meta = Get-HeuristicScore -UProjectPath $u.FullName

  $dir  = Split-Path $u.FullName -Parent

  [pscustomobject]@{

    Score        = $meta.Score

    UProject     = $u.FullName

    ProjectDir   = $dir

    HasSource    = Test-Path (Join-Path $dir "Source")

    HasContent   = Test-Path (Join-Path $dir "Content")

    HasConfig    = Test-Path (Join-Path $dir "Config")

    SourceCount  = $meta.SourceCount

    ContentCount = $meta.ContentCount

  }

} | Sort-Object Score -Descending



$report | Export-Csv $OutCsv -NoTypeInformation



Write-Host "`nTop candidates:" -ForegroundColor Yellow

$report | Select-Object -First 10 | Format-Table -AutoSize



$best = $report | Select-Object -First 1

Write-Host "`nAUTHORITATIVE PICK:" -ForegroundColor Green

$best | Format-List



Write-Host "`nWrote CSV: $OutCsv" -ForegroundColor Green



# Emit a single-line env suggestion for chaining

$envLine = @"

`$NH_UPROJECT = "$($best.UProject)"

`$NH_PROJECTDIR = "$($best.ProjectDir)"

"@

Write-Host "`nCopy/paste this to set vars for the session:`n$envLine" -ForegroundColor Cyan

2) Tools\nh_clean_project.ps1

param(

  [Parameter(Mandatory=$true)]

  [string]$ProjectDir,



  [switch]$NukeDerivedDataCache

)



$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"



function Zap([string]$p) {

  if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $p) {

    Write-Host "Deleting: $p" -ForegroundColor DarkYellow

    Remove-Item -LiteralPath $p -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

  }

}



# Safety: must look like a UE project folder

$uproject = Get-ChildItem -Path $ProjectDir -Filter *.uproject -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1

if (-not $uproject) { throw "No .uproject found inside ProjectDir: $ProjectDir" }



Write-Host "Killing UnrealEditor (if running)..." -ForegroundColor Cyan

Get-Process UnrealEditor -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue



Zap (Join-Path $ProjectDir "Binaries")

Zap (Join-Path $ProjectDir "Intermediate")

Zap (Join-Path $ProjectDir "Saved")



if ($NukeDerivedDataCache) {

  Zap (Join-Path $ProjectDir "DerivedDataCache")

  $globalDDC = Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA "UnrealEngine\Common\DerivedDataCache"

  Zap $globalDDC

}



Write-Host "✅ Cleanup done." -ForegroundColor Green

3) Tools\nh_copy_uassets.ps1

param(

  [Parameter(Mandatory=$true)]

  [string]$VaultPath,



  [Parameter(Mandatory=$true)]

  [string]$ProjectDir,



  [string]$DestSubdir = "PrisonCore"

)



$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"



if (!(Test-Path $VaultPath)) { throw "VaultPath not found: $VaultPath" }

if (!(Test-Path $ProjectDir)) { throw "ProjectDir not found: $ProjectDir" }



$uproject = Get-ChildItem -Path $ProjectDir -Filter *.uproject -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1

if (-not $uproject) { throw "No .uproject found inside ProjectDir: $ProjectDir" }



$dest = Join-Path $ProjectDir ("Content\" + $DestSubdir)

New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $dest | Out-Null



Write-Host "Copying .uasset/.umap into: $dest" -ForegroundColor Cyan



$items = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $VaultPath -Recurse -Force -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |

  Where-Object { $_.Extension -in ".uasset",".umap" }



if (-not $items) {

  Write-Host "No .uasset/.umap found under vault: $VaultPath" -ForegroundColor Yellow

  exit 0

}



$copied = 0

foreach ($it in $items) {

  $rel = $it.FullName.Substring($VaultPath.Length).TrimStart('\')

  $target = Join-Path $dest $rel

  $targetDir = Split-Path -Parent $target

  New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $targetDir | Out-Null

  Copy-Item -LiteralPath $it.FullName -Destination $target -Force

  $copied++

}



Write-Host ("✅ Copied {0} assets." -f $copied) -ForegroundColor Green

# Nyghtshade Foreman Pack (Windows + UE 5.7)



## The rules (because computers are literal)

- Run PowerShell scripts from the *workspace/project*, not C:\Windows\System32.

- Unreal Python runs inside Unreal (Python Console / -ExecutePythonScript), not in PowerShell.

# Unreal Python (runs inside Unreal, not PowerShell)

## `Content\Python\vault_to_unreal.py`



This script imports **FBX + PNG** from your vault, creates **three master materials**, creates **material instances per mesh**, assigns textures using filename hints, assigns the MI to the mesh, then **fixes redirectors**.



```python

import os

import re

import unreal



# =========================

# CONFIG

# =========================

VAULT_ROOT = r"C:\Nyghtshade_Assets_Vault"

DEST_ROOT  = "/Game/Nyghtshade/Final_Prison_Assets"



TEXTURES_DIR = f"{DEST_ROOT}/Textures"

MESHES_DIR   = f"{DEST_ROOT}/Meshes"

MATS_DIR     = f"{DEST_ROOT}/Materials"



CONCRETE_HINTS = ("concrete", "cement", "wall", "floor", "stone", "brick")

METAL_HINTS    = ("metal", "steel", "iron", "pipe", "grate", "bar", "mesh")



# =========================

# HELPERS

# =========================

def log(msg: str):

    unreal.log(str(msg))



def ensure_dir(path: str):

    if not unreal.EditorAssetLibrary.does_directory_exist(path):

        unreal.EditorAssetLibrary.make_directory(path)



def find_files(root: str, exts: tuple[str, ...]):

    out = []

    for base, _, files in os.walk(root):

        for f in files:

            ext = os.path.splitext(f)[1].lower()

            if ext in exts:

                out.append(os.path.join(base, f))

    return out



def safe_asset_name(s: str) -> str:

    s = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9_]+", "_", s)

    s = re.sub(r"_+", "_", s).strip("_")

    return s[:120] if len(s) > 120 else s



def import_file(src_path: str, dest_path: str, replace=True):

    task = unreal.AssetImportTask()

    task.filename = src_path

    task.destination_path = dest_path

    task.automated = True

    task.replace_existing = replace

    task.save = True

    unreal.AssetToolsHelpers.get_asset_tools().import_asset_tasks([task])

    return list(task.imported_object_paths or [])



def make_master_material(name: str, dest_path: str):

    ensure_dir(dest_path)

    pkg = f"{dest_path}/{name}"

    if unreal.EditorAssetLibrary.does_asset_exist(pkg):

        return unreal.load_asset(pkg)



    tools = unreal.AssetToolsHelpers.get_asset_tools()

    mat = tools.create_asset(name, dest_path, unreal.Material, unreal.MaterialFactoryNew())

    mel = unreal.MaterialEditingLibrary



    # BaseColor texture param

    base_param = mel.create_material_expression(mat, unreal.MaterialExpressionTextureSampleParameter2D, -600, 0)

    base_param.set_editor_property("parameter_name", "BaseColorTex")



    # Normal texture param

    norm_param = mel.create_material_expression(mat, unreal.MaterialExpressionTextureSampleParameter2D, -600, 220)

    norm_param.set_editor_property("parameter_name", "NormalTex")

    norm_param.set_editor_property("sampler_type", unreal.MaterialSamplerType.SAMPLERTYPE_NORMAL)



    mel.connect_material_property(base_param, "RGB", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_BASE_COLOR)

    mel.connect_material_property(norm_param, "RGB", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_NORMAL)



    mel.recompile_material(mat)

    unreal.EditorAssetLibrary.save_asset(pkg)

    return mat



def make_material_instance(mi_name: str, parent_mat, dest_path: str):

    ensure_dir(dest_path)

    pkg = f"{dest_path}/{mi_name}"

    if unreal.EditorAssetLibrary.does_asset_exist(pkg):

        return unreal.load_asset(pkg)



    tools = unreal.AssetToolsHelpers.get_asset_tools()

    mi = tools.create_asset(mi_name, dest_path, unreal.MaterialInstanceConstant, unreal.MaterialInstanceConstantFactoryNew())

    mi.set_editor_property("parent", parent_mat)

    unreal.EditorAssetLibrary.save_asset(pkg)

    return mi



def set_mi_texture(mi, param_name: str, tex_asset):

    unreal.MaterialEditingLibrary.set_material_instance_texture_parameter_value(mi, param_name, tex_asset)

    unreal.EditorAssetLibrary.save_loaded_asset(mi)



def choose_master_for_name(asset_name_lower: str) -> str:

    if any(h in asset_name_lower for h in METAL_HINTS):

        return "Master_Metal"

    if any(h in asset_name_lower for h in CONCRETE_HINTS):

        return "Master_Concrete"

    return "Master_Prison"



def guess_texture_role(filename_lower: str) -> str:

    # crude but effective

    if "normal" in filename_lower or filename_lower.endswith("_n") or "_n_" in filename_lower or filename_lower.endswith("_n.png"):

        return "NormalTex"

    return "BaseColorTex"



def assign_materials_to_mesh(mesh_asset, material_asset):

    if not isinstance(mesh_asset, unreal.StaticMesh):

        return

    slots = list(mesh_asset.get_editor_property("static_materials"))

    for i in range(len(slots)):

        slots[i].material_interface = material_asset

    mesh_asset.set_editor_property("static_materials", slots)

    mesh_asset.mark_package_dirty()

    unreal.EditorAssetLibrary.save_loaded_asset(mesh_asset)



# =========================

# MAIN

# =========================

def run():

    if not os.path.isdir(VAULT_ROOT):

        raise RuntimeError(f"Vault path not found: {VAULT_ROOT}")



    ensure_dir(DEST_ROOT)

    ensure_dir(TEXTURES_DIR)

    ensure_dir(MESHES_DIR)

    ensure_dir(MATS_DIR)



    master_prison = make_master_material("Master_Prison",   MATS_DIR)

    master_conc   = make_master_material("Master_Concrete", MATS_DIR)

    master_metal  = make_master_material("Master_Metal",    MATS_DIR)



    masters = {

        "Master_Prison": master_prison,

        "Master_Concrete": master_conc,

        "Master_Metal": master_metal,

    }



    fbx_files = find_files(VAULT_ROOT, (".fbx",))

    png_files = find_files(VAULT_ROOT, (".png", ".tga", ".jpg", ".jpeg"))



    log(f"Found FBX: {len(fbx_files)} | Textures: {len(png_files)}")



    # Import textures first

    texture_map = {}  # key: (folder_lower, basename_lower) -> texture asset

    for p in png_files:

        imported = import_file(p, TEXTURES_DIR)

        for obj_path in imported:

            tex = unreal.load_asset(obj_path)

            if isinstance(tex, unreal.Texture):

                key = (os.path.dirname(p).lower(), os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(p))[0].lower())

                texture_map[key] = tex



    # Import meshes and wire materials

    for fbx in fbx_files:

        base_name = safe_asset_name(os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(fbx))[0])

        imported = import_file(fbx, MESHES_DIR)



        mesh = None

        for obj_path in imported:

            obj = unreal.load_asset(obj_path)

            if isinstance(obj, unreal.StaticMesh):

                mesh = obj

                break



        if not mesh:

            log(f"Skipping (no StaticMesh found): {fbx}")

            continue



        master_key = choose_master_for_name(base_name.lower())

        parent = masters.get(master_key, master_prison)



        mi = make_material_instance(f"MI_{base_name}", parent, MATS_DIR)



        folder = os.path.dirname(fbx).lower()



        # Candidates: textures in same folder whose basename contains mesh basename

        candidates = []

        bn_lower = base_name.lower()

        for (fld, bn), tex in texture_map.items():

            if fld == folder and (bn.startswith(bn_lower) or bn_lower in bn):

                candidates.append((bn, tex))



        for bn, tex in candidates:

            role = guess_texture_role(bn)

            set_mi_texture(mi, role, tex)



        assign_materials_to_mesh(mesh, mi)



    # Fixup Redirectors

    asset_tools = unreal.AssetToolsHelpers.get_asset_tools()

    redir_objs = []

    for a in unreal.EditorAssetLibrary.list_assets(DEST_ROOT, recursive=True, include_folder=False):

        obj = unreal.load_asset(a)

        if isinstance(obj, unreal.ObjectRedirector):

            redir_objs.append(obj)



    if redir_objs:

        asset_tools.fixup_redirectors(redir_objs)



    log("✅ Vault import + material assignment + redirector fixup complete.")



if __name__ == "__main__":

    run()

Build.cs guard (WITH_* defines)

Patch your module Build.cs (you said Nyghtshade.Build.cs). If it doesn’t exist yet, create it, but normally Unreal already has one for your primary module.



Source\Nyghtshade\Nyghtshade.Build.cs

using UnrealBuildTool;

using System;

using System.IO;



public class Nyghtshade : ModuleRules

{

	public Nyghtshade(ReadOnlyTargetRules Target) : base(Target)

	{

		PCHUsage = PCHUsageMode.UseExplicitOrSharedPCHs;



		PublicDependencyModuleNames.AddRange(new string[]

		{

			"Core",

			"CoreUObject",

			"Engine",

			"InputCore"

		});



		PrivateDependencyModuleNames.AddRange(new string[]

		{

			"Projects"

		});



		// Project root = .../Source/Nyghtshade/ -> go up 2 levels to Source, then up 1 to project

		string ProjectRoot = Path.GetFullPath(Path.Combine(ModuleDirectory, "..", ".."));



		string CrownRoot = Path.Combine(ProjectRoot, "crown-master");

		bool bHasCrown = Directory.Exists(CrownRoot);



		string IntegratedDynamicsRoot = Path.Combine(ProjectRoot, "IntegratedDynamics");

		bool bHasIntegratedDynamics = Directory.Exists(IntegratedDynamicsRoot);



		PublicDefinitions.Add(bHasCrown ? "WITH_CROWN=1" : "WITH_CROWN=0");

		PublicDefinitions.Add(bHasIntegratedDynamics ? "WITH_INTEGRATED_DYNAMICS=1" : "WITH_INTEGRATED_DYNAMICS=0");



		// Optional include paths if they exist

		if (bHasCrown)

		{

			string CrownSource = Path.Combine(CrownRoot, "Source");

			if (Directory.Exists(CrownSource))

			{

				PrivateIncludePaths.Add(CrownSource);

			}

		}



		if (bHasIntegratedDynamics)

		{

			string IDS = Path.Combine(IntegratedDynamicsRoot, "Source");

			if (Directory.Exists(IDS))

			{

				PrivateIncludePaths.Add(IDS);

			}

		}

	}

}

# Make-ForemanPack.ps1

# Creates the Foreman Pack file tree + full file contents (no placeholders).



[CmdletBinding()]

param(

  [Parameter(Mandatory=$false)]

  [string]$Root = (Get-Location).Path,



  [switch]$Force

)



Set-StrictMode -Version Latest

$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"



function Write-File {

  param(

    [Parameter(Mandatory=$true)][string]$Path,

    [Parameter(Mandatory=$true)][string]$Content

  )

  $full = Join-Path $Root $Path

  $dir  = Split-Path -Parent $full

  if (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath $dir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dir -Force | Out-Null }



  if ((Test-Path -LiteralPath $full) -and -not $Force) {

    Write-Host "SKIP (exists): $Path  (use -Force to overwrite)" -ForegroundColor Yellow

    return

  }



  $utf8NoBom = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)

  [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($full, $Content, $utf8NoBom)

  Write-Host "WROTE: $Path" -ForegroundColor Green

}

$nh_foreman_audit = @'

[CmdletBinding()]

param(

  [Parameter(Mandatory=$true)]

  [string]$WorkspaceRoot,



  [string[]]$Roots = @(

    "$env:USERPROFILE\Desktop",

    "$env:USERPROFILE\Documents\Unreal Projects",

    "$env:USERPROFILE\Desktop\ltvall",

    "D:\",

    "C:\"

  ),



  [string]$OutCsv = (Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE "Desktop\NH_UPROJECT_AUDIT.csv"),



  [switch]$PickBest

)



Set-StrictMode -Version Latest

$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"



function Score-UProject {

  param([string]$UProjectPath)

  $dir = Split-Path -Parent $UProjectPath



  $hasSource  = Test-Path (Join-Path $dir "Source")

  $hasContent = Test-Path (Join-Path $dir "Content")

  $hasConfig  = Test-Path (Join-Path $dir "Config")

  $isTemplate = $UProjectPath -like "*\Program Files\Epic Games\*\Templates\*"

  $isEngine   = $UProjectPath -like "*\Program Files\Epic Games\*\Engine\*"



  $sourceCount  = 0

  $contentCount = 0

  if ($hasSource)  { $sourceCount  = (Get-ChildItem (Join-Path $dir "Source")  -Recurse -File -EA SilentlyContinue | Measure-Object).Count }

  if ($hasContent) { $contentCount = (Get-ChildItem (Join-Path $dir "Content") -Recurse -File -EA SilentlyContinue | Measure-Object).Count }



  # Heuristic scoring:

  # - Prefer real projects over templates/engine programs

  # - Prefer having Source/Content/Config

  # - Prefer more content + some source

  $score = 0

  if ($hasContent) { $score += 200 }

  if ($hasConfig)  { $score += 50 }

  if ($hasSource)  { $score += 120 }

  if ($contentCount -gt 0) { $score += [Math]::Min(400, [int]([Math]::Log10($contentCount + 1) * 200)) }

  if ($sourceCount  -gt 0) { $score += [Math]::Min(250, [int]([Math]::Log10($sourceCount  + 1) * 150)) }



  if ($isTemplate) { $score -= 1000 }

  if ($isEngine)   { $score -= 800 }



  # Prefer things under the workspace root

  if ($UProjectPath.StartsWith($WorkspaceRoot, [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) {

    $score += 250

  }



  [pscustomobject]@{

    UProject      = $UProjectPath

    ProjectDir    = $dir

    Score         = $score

    HasSource     = $hasSource

    HasContent    = $hasContent

    HasConfig     = $hasConfig

    SourceCount   = $sourceCount

    ContentCount  = $contentCount

    IsTemplate    = $isTemplate

    IsEngine      = $isEngine

  }

}



if (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath $WorkspaceRoot)) {

  throw "WorkspaceRoot not found: $WorkspaceRoot"

}



$scanRoots = @($WorkspaceRoot) + ($Roots | Where-Object { $_ -and (Test-Path $_) } | Select-Object -Unique)



Write-Host "=== Foreman Audit ===" -ForegroundColor Cyan

Write-Host "WorkspaceRoot: $WorkspaceRoot"

Write-Host "Scan roots:"; $scanRoots | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "  - $_" }



$uprojects = foreach ($r in $scanRoots) {

  Get-ChildItem -Path $r -Filter *.uproject -Recurse -Force -EA SilentlyContinue

}



if (!$uprojects) {

  Write-Host "No .uproject files found." -ForegroundColor Red

  exit 2

}



$report = $uprojects | ForEach-Object { Score-UProject $_.FullName } | Sort-Object Score -Descending



$report | Export-Csv -NoTypeInformation -Path $OutCsv

Write-Host "Wrote CSV: $OutCsv" -ForegroundColor Green



$top = $report | Select-Object -First 10

Write-Host "`nTop candidates:" -ForegroundColor Cyan

$top | Format-Table Score,UProject,HasSource,HasContent,SourceCount,ContentCount -AutoSize



if ($PickBest) {

  $best = $report | Select-Object -First 1

  Write-Host "`nBEST:" -ForegroundColor Green

  $best | Format-List

  # Print only the path last (easy copy)

  Write-Output $best.UProject

}

'@

$nh_clean_project = @'

[CmdletBinding()]

param(

  [Parameter(Mandatory=$true)]

  [string]$ProjectDir,



  [switch]$NukeDerivedDataCache,

  [switch]$AlsoGlobalDDC

)



Set-StrictMode -Version Latest

$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"



function Zap([string]$p) {

  if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($p)) { return }

  if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $p) {

    Write-Host "Deleting: $p" -ForegroundColor Yellow

    Remove-Item -LiteralPath $p -Recurse -Force -EA SilentlyContinue

  }

}



if (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath $ProjectDir)) {

  throw "ProjectDir not found: $ProjectDir"

}



# Kill Unreal Editor if running

Get-Process UnrealEditor -EA SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force -EA SilentlyContinue



Zap (Join-Path $ProjectDir "Binaries")

Zap (Join-Path $ProjectDir "Intermediate")

Zap (Join-Path $ProjectDir "Saved")



if ($NukeDerivedDataCache) {

  Zap (Join-Path $ProjectDir "DerivedDataCache")

}



if ($AlsoGlobalDDC) {

  $globalDDC = Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA "UnrealEngine\Common\DerivedDataCache"

  Zap $globalDDC

}



Write-Host "✅ Cleanup done." -ForegroundColor Green

'@

$nh_copy_uassets = @'

[CmdletBinding()]

param(

  [Parameter(Mandatory=$true)]

  [string]$VaultPath,



  [Parameter(Mandatory=$true)]

  [string]$ProjectDir,



  [string]$DestSubdir = "PrisonCore",



  [switch]$UseRobocopy

)



Set-StrictMode -Version Latest

$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"



if (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath $VaultPath))   { throw "VaultPath not found: $VaultPath" }

if (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath $ProjectDir))  { throw "ProjectDir not found: $ProjectDir" }



$dest = Join-Path $ProjectDir "Content\$DestSubdir"

New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $dest | Out-Null



Write-Host "Copying .uasset/.umap from:" -ForegroundColor Cyan

Write-Host "  Vault: $VaultPath"

Write-Host "  Dest : $dest"



# If robocopy requested and available, use it (faster + preserves structure cleanly)

if ($UseRobocopy -and (Get-Command robocopy.exe -EA SilentlyContinue)) {

  $args = @(

    "`"$VaultPath`"",

    "`"$dest`"",

    "*.uasset",

    "*.umap",

    "/E",

    "/R:1",

    "/W:1",

    "/NFL","/NDL","/NJH","/NJS","/NP"

  )

  & robocopy @args | Out-Host

  Write-Host "✅ Robocopy pass complete." -ForegroundColor Green

  exit 0

}



# Pure PowerShell copy (slower but works everywhere)

$items = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $VaultPath -Recurse -Force -File -EA SilentlyContinue |

  Where-Object { $_.Extension -in ".uasset",".umap" }



if (!$items) {

  Write-Host "No .uasset/.umap files found in vault." -ForegroundColor Yellow

  exit 0

}



foreach ($it in $items) {

  $rel = $it.FullName.Substring($VaultPath.Length).TrimStart('\','/')

  $target = Join-Path $dest $rel

  $targetDir = Split-Path -Parent $target

  if (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath $targetDir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $targetDir | Out-Null }

  Copy-Item -LiteralPath $it.FullName -Destination $target -Force

}



Write-Host ("✅ Copied {0} assets." -f $items.Count) -ForegroundColor Green

'@

$nh_build_safe = @'

[CmdletBinding()]

param(

  [Parameter(Mandatory=$true)]

  [string]$UProjectPath,



  [Parameter(Mandatory=$true)]

  [string]$UE57Root,



  [ValidateSet("Win64")]

  [string]$Platform = "Win64",



  [ValidateSet("Development","DebugGame","Shipping")]

  [string]$Config = "Development",



  [int]$MaxParallelActions = 6,



  [switch]$RegenerateProjectFiles

)



Set-StrictMode -Version Latest

$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"



if (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath $UProjectPath)) { throw "UProjectPath not found: $UProjectPath" }

if (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath $UE57Root))     { throw "UE57Root not found: $UE57Root" }



$buildBat = Join-Path $UE57Root "Engine\Build\BatchFiles\Build.bat"

$gpfBat   = Join-Path $UE57Root "Engine\Build\BatchFiles\GenerateProjectFiles.bat"



if (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath $buildBat)) { throw "Build.bat not found: $buildBat" }



$projName = [IO.Path]::GetFileNameWithoutExtension($UProjectPath)

$target   = "${projName}Editor"



# Kill any editor leftovers

Get-Process UnrealEditor -EA SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force -EA SilentlyContinue



if ($RegenerateProjectFiles) {

  if (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath $gpfBat)) { throw "GenerateProjectFiles.bat not found: $gpfBat" }

  Write-Host "Regenerating project files..." -ForegroundColor Cyan

  & $gpfBat "-Project=$UProjectPath" -Game -Engine | Out-Host

}



Write-Host "Building $target ($Platform/$Config) MaxParallelActions=$MaxParallelActions" -ForegroundColor Cyan

& $buildBat $target $Platform $Config "-Project=$UProjectPath" -WaitMutex "-MaxParallelActions=$MaxParallelActions" | Out-Host



Write-Host "✅ Build finished." -ForegroundColor Green

'@

$nh_git_init_ue = @'

[CmdletBinding()]

param(

  [Parameter(Mandatory=$true)]

  [string]$RepoRoot,



  [string]$RemoteUrl = "",



  [string]$DefaultBranch = "main"

)



Set-StrictMode -Version Latest

$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"



if (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath $RepoRoot)) { throw "RepoRoot not found: $RepoRoot" }



function Run([string]$cmd) {

  Write-Host ">> $cmd" -ForegroundColor DarkGray

  cmd.exe /c $cmd

  if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Command failed: $cmd" }

}



Push-Location $RepoRoot

try {

  if (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $RepoRoot ".git"))) {

    Run "git init"

  }



  # Ensure branch name

  Run "git checkout -B $DefaultBranch"



  # LFS

  Run "git lfs install"



  # .gitattributes for UE assets

  $ga = Join-Path $RepoRoot ".gitattributes"

  if (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath $ga)) {

    @"

*.uasset filter=lfs diff=lfs merge=lfs -text

*.umap   filter=lfs diff=lfs merge=lfs -text

*.fbx    filter=lfs diff=lfs merge=lfs -text

*.png    filter=lfs diff=lfs merge=lfs -text

*.tga    filter=lfs diff=lfs merge=lfs -text

*.wav    filter=lfs diff=lfs merge=lfs -text

"@ | Set-Content -Path $ga -Encoding utf8

  }



  # .gitignore (standard UE)

  $gi = Join-Path $RepoRoot ".gitignore"

  if (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath $gi)) {

    @"

# Unreal Engine

Binaries/

DerivedDataCache/

Intermediate/

Saved/

.vscode/

.vs/

*.sln

*.opensdf

*.sdf

*.suo

*.user

*.userprefs

*.VC.db

*.VC.VC.opendb

*.pdb

*.log



# Build artifacts

Build/

"@ | Set-Content -Path $gi -Encoding utf8

  }



  Run "git add .gitattributes .gitignore"

  Run "git add -A"

  Run "git commit -m `"Initialize UE repo + LFS tracking`""



  if ($RemoteUrl -and $RemoteUrl.Trim().Length -gt 0) {

    $existing = (git remote) 2>$null

    if ($existing -notcontains "origin") {

      Run "git remote add origin $RemoteUrl"

    } else {

      Run "git remote set-url origin $RemoteUrl"

    }

    Run "git push -u origin $DefaultBranch"

  }



  Write-Host "✅ Git init complete." -ForegroundColor Green

}

finally {

  Pop-Location

}

'@



# ---------------------------

# Content\Python\vault_to_unreal.py

# ---------------------------

$vault_to_unreal = @'

# vault_to_unreal.py

# Run INSIDE Unreal Editor (Python enabled) or via:

# UnrealEditor.exe "Path\Project.uproject" -ExecutePythonScript="...\Content\Python\vault_to_unreal.py"

#

# What it does:

# - Imports FBX + PNG from a vault folder into /Game/Nyghtshade/Final_Prison_Assets

# - Creates simple master materials (BaseColor + Normal)

# - Creates material instances per mesh and assigns best-guess textures

# - Assigns MI to static meshes

# - Fixes up redirectors



import os

import re

import unreal



# ------------------------

# CONFIG

# ------------------------

VAULT_ROOT = r"C:\Nyghtshade_Assets_Vault"

DEST_ROOT  = "/Game/Nyghtshade/Final_Prison_Assets"



TEXTURES_DIR = f"{DEST_ROOT}/Textures"

MESHES_DIR   = f"{DEST_ROOT}/Meshes"

MATS_DIR     = f"{DEST_ROOT}/Materials"



CONCRETE_HINTS = ("concrete", "cement", "wall", "floor", "stone")

METAL_HINTS    = ("metal", "steel", "iron", "pipe", "grate", "bar")



# ------------------------

# HELPERS

# ------------------------

def log(msg: str):

    unreal.log(f"[Foreman] {msg}")



def warn(msg: str):

    unreal.log_warning(f"[Foreman] {msg}")



def err(msg: str):

    unreal.log_error(f"[Foreman] {msg}")



def ensure_dir(path: str):

    if not unreal.EditorAssetLibrary.does_directory_exist(path):

        unreal.EditorAssetLibrary.make_directory(path)



def safe_asset_name(s: str) -> str:

    s = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9_]+", "_", s)

    s = re.sub(r"_+", "_", s).strip("_")

    if not s:

        s = "Asset"

    return s[:120]



def find_files(root: str, exts: set):

    out = []

    for base, _, files in os.walk(root):

        for f in files:

            ext = os.path.splitext(f)[1].lower()

            if ext in exts:

                out.append(os.path.join(base, f))

    return out



def import_file(src_path: str, dest_path: str, automated=True, replace=True):

    task = unreal.AssetImportTask()

    task.filename = src_path

    task.destination_path = dest_path

    task.automated = automated

    task.replace_existing = replace

    task.save = True



    unreal.AssetToolsHelpers.get_asset_tools().import_asset_tasks([task])

    return list(task.imported_object_paths or [])



def make_master_material(name: str, dest_path: str):

    ensure_dir(dest_path)

    pkg = f"{dest_path}/{name}"



    if unreal.EditorAssetLibrary.does_asset_exist(pkg):

        return unreal.load_asset(pkg)



    mat = unreal.AssetToolsHelpers.get_asset_tools().create_asset(

        name, dest_path, unreal.Material, unreal.MaterialFactoryNew()

    )



    mel = unreal.MaterialEditingLibrary



    # BaseColor param

    base_param = mel.create_material_expression(mat, unreal.MaterialExpressionTextureSampleParameter2D, -600, 0)

    base_param.parameter_name = "BaseColorTex"



    # Normal param

    norm_param = mel.create_material_expression(mat, unreal.MaterialExpressionTextureSampleParameter2D, -600, 220)

    norm_param.parameter_name = "NormalTex"

    norm_param.sampler_type = unreal.MaterialSamplerType.SAMPLERTYPE_NORMAL



    # Roughness constant (slightly rough by default)

    rough = mel.create_material_expression(mat, unreal.MaterialExpressionConstant, -600, 420)

    rough.set_editor_property("r", 0.7)



    mel.connect_material_property(base_param, "RGB", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_BASE_COLOR)

    mel.connect_material_property(norm_param, "RGB", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_NORMAL)

    mel.connect_material_property(rough, "R", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_ROUGHNESS)



    mel.recompile_material(mat)

    unreal.EditorAssetLibrary.save_asset(pkg)

    return mat



def make_material_instance(mi_name: str, parent_mat, dest_path: str):

    ensure_dir(dest_path)

    pkg = f"{dest_path}/{mi_name}"



    if unreal.EditorAssetLibrary.does_asset_exist(pkg):

        return unreal.load_asset(pkg)



    mi = unreal.AssetToolsHelpers.get_asset_tools().create_asset(

        mi_name, dest_path, unreal.MaterialInstanceConstant, unreal.MaterialInstanceConstantFactoryNew()

    )

    mi.set_editor_property("parent", parent_mat)

    unreal.EditorAssetLibrary.save_asset(pkg)

    return mi



def set_mi_texture(mi, param_name: str, tex_asset):

    unreal.MaterialEditingLibrary.set_material_instance_texture_parameter_value(mi, param_name, tex_asset)

    unreal.EditorAssetLibrary.save_loaded_asset(mi)



def choose_master_for_name(asset_name_lower: str) -> str:

    if any(h in asset_name_lower for h in METAL_HINTS):

        return "Master_Metal"

    if any(h in asset_name_lower for h in CONCRETE_HINTS):

        return "Master_Concrete"

    return "Master_Prison"



def guess_texture_role(filename_lower: str) -> str:

    # crude but effective heuristics

    if "normal" in filename_lower or filename_lower.endswith("_n") or "_n_" in filename_lower or filename_lower.endswith("_nrm"):

        return "NormalTex"

    return "BaseColorTex"



def assign_materials_to_mesh(mesh_asset, material_asset):

    if not isinstance(mesh_asset, unreal.StaticMesh):

        return

    slots = list(mesh_asset.get_editor_property("static_materials") or [])

    if not slots:

        return

    for i in range(len(slots)):

        slots[i].material_interface = material_asset

    mesh_asset.set_editor_property("static_materials", slots)

    mesh_asset.mark_package_dirty()

    unreal.EditorAssetLibrary.save_loaded_asset(mesh_asset)



def fixup_redirectors(root_path: str):

    asset_tools = unreal.AssetToolsHelpers.get_asset_tools()

    redirs = []

    for a in unreal.EditorAssetLibrary.list_assets(root_path, recursive=True, include_folder=False):

        obj = unreal.load_asset(a)

        if isinstance(obj, unreal.ObjectRedirector):

            redirs.append(obj)

    if redirs:

        asset_tools.fixup_redirectors(redirs)

        log(f"Fixup redirectors: {len(redirs)}")

    else:

        log("Fixup redirectors: none")



def run():

    if not os.path.isdir(VAULT_ROOT):

        err(f"Vault root not found: {VAULT_ROOT}")

        return



    ensure_dir(DEST_ROOT)

    ensure_dir(TEXTURES_DIR)

    ensure_dir(MESHES_DIR)

    ensure_dir(MATS_DIR)



    # Create masters

    master_prison = make_master_material("Master_Prison", MATS_DIR)

    master_conc   = make_master_material("Master_Concrete", MATS_DIR)

    master_metal  = make_master_material("Master_Metal", MATS_DIR)



    masters = {

        "Master_Prison": master_prison,

        "Master_Concrete": master_conc,

        "Master_Metal": master_metal,

    }



    fbx_files = find_files(VAULT_ROOT, {".fbx"})

    png_files = find_files(VAULT_ROOT, {".png"})

    log(f"Found FBX: {len(fbx_files)} | PNG: {len(png_files)}")



    # Import textures first (so we can assign them)

    texture_map = {}  # key: folderLower -> {basenameLower: textureAsset}

    for p in png_files:

        imported = import_file(p, TEXTURES_DIR)

        for obj_path in imported:

            tex = unreal.load_asset(obj_path)

            folder = os.path.dirname(p).lower()

            base = os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(p))[0].lower()

            texture_map.setdefault(folder, {})[base] = tex



    # Import meshes and wire materials

    for fbx in fbx_files:

        base_name = safe_asset_name(os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(fbx))[0])

        imported = import_file(fbx, MESHES_DIR)



        mesh = None

        for obj_path in imported:

            obj = unreal.load_asset(obj_path)

            if isinstance(obj, unreal.StaticMesh):

                mesh = obj

                break



        if not mesh:

            warn(f"Skipping (no StaticMesh found): {fbx}")

            continue



        master_key = choose_master_for_name(base_name.lower())

        parent = masters.get(master_key, master_prison)



        mi = make_material_instance(f"MI_{base_name}", parent, MATS_DIR)



        folder = os.path.dirname(fbx).lower()

        candidates = texture_map.get(folder, {})



        # Apply best guesses: match textures containing the mesh basename

        for bn, tex in candidates.items():

            if bn.startswith(base_name.lower()) or base_name.lower() in bn:

                role = guess_texture_role(bn)

                set_mi_texture(mi, role, tex)



        assign_materials_to_mesh(mesh, mi)



    fixup_redirectors(DEST_ROOT)

    log("✅ Vault import + material assignment complete.")



if __name__ == "__main__":

    run()

'@

# Source\Nyghtshade\Nyghtshade.Build.cs

# ---------------------------

$build_cs = @'

using UnrealBuildTool;

using System;

using System.IO;



public class Nyghtshade : ModuleRules

{

    public Nyghtshade(ReadOnlyTargetRules Target) : base(Target)

    {

        PCHUsage = PCHUsageMode.UseExplicitOrSharedPCHs;



        PublicDependencyModuleNames.AddRange(new string[]

        {

            "Core",

            "CoreUObject",

            "Engine",

            "InputCore",

            "Projects"

        });



        PrivateDependencyModuleNames.AddRange(new string[]

        {

            "Slate",

            "SlateCore"

        });



        // Project root: <Project>/Source/Nyghtshade -> <Project>

        string ProjectRoot = Path.GetFullPath(Path.Combine(ModuleDirectory, "..", ".."));



        // Optional externals at:

        // <Project>/crown-master

        // <Project>/IntegratedDynamics

        string CrownRoot = Path.Combine(ProjectRoot, "crown-master");

        string DynRoot   = Path.Combine(ProjectRoot, "IntegratedDynamics");



        bool HasCrown = Directory.Exists(CrownRoot);

        bool HasDyn   = Directory.Exists(DynRoot);



        PublicDefinitions.Add(HasCrown ? "WITH_CROWN=1" : "WITH_CROWN=0");

        PublicDefinitions.Add(HasDyn   ? "WITH_INTEGRATED_DYNAMICS=1" : "WITH_INTEGRATED_DYNAMICS=0");



        // Add reasonable include roots if they exist (safe even if empty)

        if (HasCrown)

        {

            AddIfExists(Path.Combine(CrownRoot, "Source"));

            AddIfExists(Path.Combine(CrownRoot, "Include"));

            AddIfExists(Path.Combine(CrownRoot, "Public"));

        }



        if (HasDyn)

        {

            AddIfExists(Path.Combine(DynRoot, "Source"));

            AddIfExists(Path.Combine(DynRoot, "Include"));

            AddIfExists(Path.Combine(DynRoot, "Public"));

        }



        // Bridge include path

        PublicIncludePaths.Add(Path.Combine(ModuleDirectory, "Public"));

        PublicIncludePaths.Add(Path.Combine(ModuleDirectory, "Public", "Bridge"));

        PrivateIncludePaths.Add(Path.Combine(ModuleDirectory, "Private"));

        PrivateIncludePaths.Add(Path.Combine(ModuleDirectory, "Private", "Bridge"));

    }



    private void AddIfExists(string PathToAdd)

    {

        if (Directory.Exists(PathToAdd))

        {

            PublicIncludePaths.Add(PathToAdd);

        }

    }

}

'@

$readme = @'

# Foreman Pack (Windows + UE 5.7)



If you run commands from `C:\Windows\System32`, PowerShell will (correctly) treat relative paths like `Tools\...` as nonexistent.

So: **CD INTO YOUR REPO ROOT FIRST.**



Example:

```powershell

cd "C:\Users\FRANK\Desktop\ltvall\shiny-happiness"

1) Audit workspace and pick the best .uproject

pwsh -File .\Tools\nh_foreman_audit.ps1 -WorkspaceRoot (Get-Location).Path -PickBest

This writes:



Desktop\NH_UPROJECT_AUDIT.csv

…and prints the best candidate path at the end.



2) Clean project build junk (safe)

pwsh -File .\Tools\nh_clean_project.ps1 -ProjectDir "C:\PATH\TO\PROJECT" -NukeDerivedDataCache -AlsoGlobalDDC

3) Copy cooked UE assets from vault (.uasset/.umap)

pwsh -File .\Tools\nh_copy_uassets.ps1 -VaultPath "C:\Nyghtshade_Assets_Vault" -ProjectDir "C:\PATH\TO\PROJECT" -DestSubdir "PrisonCore" -UseRobocopy

4) Build safely (caps parallelism)

pwsh -File .\Tools\nh_build_safe.ps1 -UProjectPath "C:\PATH\TO\PROJECT\YourProject.uproject" -UE57Root "C:\Program Files\Epic Games\UE_5.7" -MaxParallelActions 6

Important: The build target is derived from the .uproject filename:



NYGHTSHADEHOLLOW.uproject -> target NYGHTSHADEHOLLOWEditor

If you build THENYGHTSHADEHOLLOWEditor while your .uproject is named NYGHTSHADEHOLLOW.uproject, UnrealBuildTool will throw rules errors.



5) Unreal Python import (FBX+PNG) from the vault

The script is here:



Content\Python\vault_to_unreal.py



Option A: Run from Unreal Editor UI

Enable Python:



Edit -> Plugins -> Python Editor Script Plugin (enable)

Then:



Window -> Developer Tools -> Output Log

Option B: Run headless from command line

enables LFS



tracks .uasset/.umap/.fbx/.png/.tga/.wav



adds .gitignore



commits and pushes (if RemoteUrl provided)

>>     [Parameter(Mandatory=$true)][string]$Path,

>>     [Parameter(Mandatory=$true)][string]$Content

>>   )

>>   $full = Join-Path $Root $Path

>>   $dir  = Split-Path -Parent $full

>>

>>   if ((Test-Path -LiteralPath $full) -and -not $Force) {

>>     return

>>   }

>>

>>   $utf8NoBom = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)

>>   [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($full, $Content, $utf8NoBom)

>>   Write-Host "WROTE: $Path" -ForegroundColor Green

>> }

>>     HasContent    = $hasContent

>> function Write-File {

>>   param(

>>     [Parameter(Mandatory=$true)][string]$Path,

>>   )

>>   $full = Join-Path $Root $Path

>>

>>   if ((Test-Path -LiteralPath $full) -and -not $Force) {

>>   }

>>

>>   $utf8NoBom = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)

>>   [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($full, $Content, $utf8NoBom)

>> # ---------------------------

>> # Tools\nh_foreman_audit.ps1

>> # ---------------------------

>> $nh_foreman_audit = @'

>> [CmdletBinding()]

>> param(

>>   [Parameter(Mandatory=$true)]

>>   [string]$WorkspaceRoot,

>>

>>   [string[]]$Roots = @(

>>     "$env:USERPROFILE\Desktop",

>>     "$env:USERPROFILE\Documents\Unreal Projects",

>>     "$env:USERPROFILE\Desktop\ltvall",

>>     "D:\",

>>     "C:\"

>>   ),

>>

>>   [string]$OutCsv = (Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE "Desktop\NH_UPROJECT_AUDIT.csv"),

>>

>>   [switch]$PickBest

>> )

>>

>> Set-StrictMode -Version Latest

>> $ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"

>>

>> function Score-UProject {

>>   param([string]$UProjectPath)

>>   $dir = Split-Path -Parent $UProjectPath

>>

>>   $hasSource  = Test-Path (Join-Path $dir "Source")

>>   $hasContent = Test-Path (Join-Path $dir "Content")

>>   $hasConfig  = Test-Path (Join-Path $dir "Config")

>>   $isTemplate = $UProjectPath -like "*\Program Files\Epic Games\*\Templates\*"

>>   $isEngine   = $UProjectPath -like "*\Program Files\Epic Games\*\Engine\*"

>>

>>   $sourceCount  = 0

>>   $contentCount = 0

>>   if ($hasSource)  { $sourceCount  = (Get-ChildItem (Join-Path $dir "Source")  -Recurse -File -EA SilentlyContinue | Measure-Object).Count }

>>   if ($hasContent) { $contentCount = (Get-ChildItem (Join-Path $dir "Content") -Recurse -File -EA SilentlyContinue | Measure-Object).Count }

>>

>>   # Heuristic scoring:

>>   # - Prefer real projects over templates/engine programs

>>   # - Prefer having Source/Content/Config

>>   # - Prefer more content + some source

>>   $score = 0

>>   if ($hasContent) { $score += 200 }

>>   if ($hasConfig)  { $score += 50 }

>>   if ($hasSource)  { $score += 120 }

>>   if ($contentCount -gt 0) { $score += [Math]::Min(400, [int]([Math]::Log10($contentCount + 1) * 200)) }

>>   if ($sourceCount  -gt 0) { $score += [Math]::Min(250, [int]([Math]::Log10($sourceCount  + 1) * 150)) }

>>

>>   if ($isTemplate) { $score -= 1000 }

>>   if ($isEngine)   { $score -= 800 }

>>

>>   # Prefer things under the workspace root

>>   if ($UProjectPath.StartsWith($WorkspaceRoot, [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) {

>>     $score += 250

>>   }

>>

>>   [pscustomobject]@{

>>     UProject      = $UProjectPath

>>     ProjectDir    = $dir

>>     Score         = $score

>>     HasSource     = $hasSource

>>     HasContent    = $hasContent

>>     HasConfig     = $hasConfig

>>     SourceCount   = $sourceCount

>>     ContentCount  = $contentCount

>>     IsTemplate    = $isTemplate

>>     IsEngine      = $isEngine

>>   }

>> }

>>

>> if (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath $WorkspaceRoot)) {

>>   throw "WorkspaceRoot not found: $WorkspaceRoot"

>> }

>>

>> $scanRoots = @($WorkspaceRoot) + ($Roots | Where-Object { $_ -and (Test-Path $_) } | Select-Object -Unique)

>>

>> Write-Host "=== Foreman Audit ===" -ForegroundColor Cyan

>> Write-Host "WorkspaceRoot: $WorkspaceRoot"

>> Write-Host "Scan roots:"; $scanRoots | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "  - $_" }

>>

>> $uprojects = foreach ($r in $scanRoots) {

>>   Get-ChildItem -Path $r -Filter *.uproject -Recurse -Force -EA SilentlyContinue

>> }

>>

>> if (!$uprojects) {

>>   Write-Host "No .uproject files found." -ForegroundColor Red

>>   exit 2

>> }

>>

>> $report = $uprojects | ForEach-Object { Score-UProject $_.FullName } | Sort-Object Score -Descending

>>

>> $report | Export-Csv -NoTypeInformation -Path $OutCsv

>> Write-Host "Wrote CSV: $OutCsv" -ForegroundColor Green

>>

>> $top = $report | Select-Object -First 10

>> Write-Host "nTop candidates:" -ForegroundColor Cyan

>> $top |if ($PickBest) {

>>   $best = $report | Select-Object -First 1

>>   Write-Host "nBEST:" -ForegroundColor Green

>>   $best | Format-List

>>   # Print only the path last (easy copy)

>>   Write-Output $best.UProject

>> }

>> '@
